newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta faces high risk of frost Wednesday morning.
newsitem.headline: Alberta faces high risk of frost Wednesday morning.

text.p: Alberta was forecast to see a high risk of frost Wednesday morning, Environment Canada said.
A high risk of frost was also likely in southwestern Saskatchewan Wednesday morning, Environment Canada said in its 10-day frost outlook.
A high risk of frost was forecast for Alberta's south and central grainbelt and Saskatchewan's entire grainbelt Thursday and Friday mornings with a slight risk in Manitoba.
A moderate risk of frost was forecast for the Peace River Valley Saturday and Sunday mornings with a slight risk in south Manitoba and a moderate risk in north Saskatchewan.
A high risk of frost was forecast for the entire Prairie northern grainbelt Sept 30 to Oct 3.
A moderate risk was expected across the central grainbelt Sept 30 and Oct 3 while a slight risk of frost was seen on the southern grainbelt Sept 30 and Oct 1, Environment Canada said.
